title.en: An Act Declaring April 4 of Every Year A Special Nonworking Holiday in the City of Antipolo, Province of Rizal, in Commemoration of Its Cityhood Anniversary

text.en: April 4 of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking holiday in the City of Antipolo, Province of Rizal, in commemoration of its cityhood anniversary.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
